answer.verdict: One toolchain, one host runtime, two guest images, two exes. A third branch replays patches; do not git-merge us-iso into master and do not link both generated trees (141 FUN_<addr> collisions). Patches 01-32 are body-identical. Music is three fixes written twice: take US 36 ISO9660, PAL 36 SIF/IOP plus US 33 SIF.cpp, and PAL 41 SPU2 IRQ. PAL graphics/controls and US rollback/netplay/perf are complementary and must be renumbered (14 files conflict after patch 32). Overrides are one apply() compiled twice against a generated DiscAddrs table. A PAL player and a US player cannot meet: HELLO refuses a different build id, and that id includes the ELF SHA-1, while netHashOf covers full RDRAM with different layouts. Same-disc online is the product. Plan: docs/SUPER_RECOMPILER.md section 5, steps 1-13.
